subject: Re: POC plan and success criteria / Clearsight AI
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Carter <olivia@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan and success criteria / Clearsight AI

Hi Olivia — great meeting today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed POC plan below so we can lock timelines and owners.

Summary of ask:
- Validate Redwood Inference for Clearsight's summarization pipeline on 4M monthly docs (PDFs + HTML).
- Confirm latency and cost targets for 99th%-ile inference across a 2–6 token-per-second request profile.

Proposed POC (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week) — kickoff + infra prep
   - Deliverables: shared scope doc (attached), sample data extract, access methods
   - Owners: Marissa (program owner), Marcus (SE lead), Clearsight: Olivia (POC lead)
2) Week 1 — baseline tests
   - Run Redwood-hosted Dedicated instance with sample data, collect latency/cost metrics
   - Success metric: baseline throughput >= 80% of required, p95 latency < 250ms for typical docs
3) Week 2 — workload tuning + quality eval
   - Apply batching/kv-cache policies, run auto-quantized variant if needed
   - Success metric: ROUGE-L on summaries within 3 points of current golden set; token cost <= $0.003/token (target)
4) Week 3 — final validation + handoff
   - Run a 24-hour simulated load, export findings, and a mutual action plan for production rollout

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Olivia: share a sample data extract (single doc CSV or small S3 location) by Fri 7/31
- Clearsight security: if you need a data processing addendum, loop in procurement (cc'd)
- Marcus/Ethan: confirm availability for kickoff (we propose Mon 8/2 at 10am PT)

Attachments:
- POC-scope-Clearsight.pdf (attached)

If that looks right I’ll schedule the kickoff and create the HubSpot timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

- Success criteria tweaks:
  - Latency: p95 < 300ms for the short documents (our production SLA is 350ms, so buffer is fine)
  - Quality: if ROUGE-L delta is > 4 points vs our golden set we’ll need a model/parameter change conversation
  - Cost target: we’re flexible but would like to see an estimate at the end of Week 1 for ops budgeting

- Data: attaching a small sample extract (data-extract-sample.csv) — 150 rows, mix of PDFs and HTML. If you need additional metadata fields let me know.
- Security: procurement copied. We’ll need a standard DPA; procurement will send the template if needed.
- Kickoff: 8/2 10am PT works for me. Please send calendar invite.

Looking forward to it.
